text:
Anya: Heads up — after the kernelselect tweak from yesterday I'm seeing ~+15% median token latency on our 8xA100 TP2/PP4 job. Repro on two clusters but worse on PCIe-only racks.
Sam: Which racks/nodes? NVLink vs PCIe mix?
Anya: PCIe-only (rack-05, rack-07). NVLink racks (rack-01) have smaller regression (~+3%).
Leon: Did you capture a timeline? suspect all-reduce wait spikes and KV-cache churn.
Anya: Yea, attached quick flame from our perf probe job (ci/reports/28712). Snip: 

```
timeline summary:
- compute: 120ms
- allreduce_wait: 64ms  <-- spikes during kv sync
- kvcache_miss_handlers: 6 x 28-35ms
- effective latency/token: +15%
```

Mike: KV misses that large per shard are suspicious — could be eviction/rehash thrash after kernel change. Which kernelselect commit?
Anya: sha: f9c2a7b (kernelselect heur v3). Reverting to v2 on one PCIe node restored baseline.
Sam: Sounds like k/s picked a kernel that increases memory working set leading to PCIe copies and extra NVLink-less hops. On NVLink nodes the HW path hides it.
Leon: Two quick mitigations: 1) force hierarchical all-reduce (env: RI_ALLREDUCE=hierarchical) 2) pin kernelselect to v2 until we fix kvprefetch heuristics. Both lowered token latency by ~8% in local runs.
Sasha: @Anya can you run the comm-probe job with `--comm-probe=timeline --agg=ring,hier` and paste results? I can compare ring vs hierarchical.
Anya: Running now, job id bench/5521. Output excerpt: 

```
comm-probe bench/5521:
- ring avg allreduce: 72ms (PCIe racks)
- hierarchical avg allreduce: 38ms (PCIe racks)
- nvlink racks: ring 40ms / hierarchical 36ms
- kvcache hitrate: v3=86% vs v2=92%
```

Sam: That's the smoking gun — v3 reduced KV hitrate causing extra fetches across PCIe, amplifying ring allreduce tail.
Leon: Action plan: revert kernelselect on next canary, add a safety gate: if kvcache_hitrate drop > 3% then prefer kernel that preserves working set, and add an operator flag to prefer hierarchical collectives for PCIe-only domains.
infra-bot: Deploy job bench/5521 completed. Canary revert queued: deploy/rollout-8021.
Mike: I'll dig into kv eviction heuristics — maybe the kernel changed block layout or padding. Quick probe: run `ri-tools kvstats --sample 1000 --dump-shards` and attach; looking for per-shard variance.
Anya: Pinned v2 on prod-canary and set RI_ALLREDUCE=hierarchical for PCIe nodes as stopgap. Numbers look back to baseline. Will follow up with full profiling + a microbenchmark reproducer by EOD. :thumbsup:
Leon: Thanks — add regression ticket and link perf traces. I'll pick up kernelselect remediation tomorrow.
Sasha: I'll notify oncall and add note to runbook for PCIe-only clusters. :eyes:
